This directly falls under 'Performing read, write/delete operations on system or other users' files,' specifically sensitive user data files.

An entitlement granting access to 'MessagesMetaData' would either bypass standard user consent for this sensitive data or be part of the mechanism that grants privileged access to it for trusted Apple processes, thereby relating to TCC-protected resources.
